parsed.strategy_update: Full exit on MOON at $0.005 to lock in 5x gains. Reduced ETH exposure by closing 5x leverage position, keeping only 3x long as a runner for CryptoGuru's $2900 call. Moving to defensive position with increased USDT reserves to deploy on the next opportunity.
parsed.lessons_learned: When whales start taking profits and the entire chat is bullish, it's time to exit. The profit-taking cascade from DiamondHands and HappyTrader was the signal I needed to sell everything - not just half. $0.005 was a lucky gift that let me exit higher than my original $0.002 target. On ETH, hedging my leverage exposure is smart - keep some skin in the game but reduce liquidation risk.
